name: MaxLearnsMath
description: Math stories in 2 minutes 🧮 Follow Max as he figures it out ✨

fonts.math: STIX Two Text, Times New Roman, serif

notes: Extracted from the original casino reel and upgraded. Navy #003049 backdrop (animated aurora + dot grid in the template). Charts live in code-editor panels (#0b3c5c, filename tab like bankroll.plot). Crimson #c1121f = Max, losses, key results; maroon #780000 = shading/hair; steel blue #669bbc = axes, labels, other players; cream #fdf0d5 = text; ink #131315 = roulette black; teal #2a9d8f = rare accent (the zero). Type roles: JetBrains Mono for labels/numbers/chapter badges, Inter for narration and titles, STIX Two for equations. Narration renders as a terminal typewriter line (crimson prompt, block cursor). Mascot: Max - curly maroon hair, round glasses, crimson hoodie with a pi badge. Logo pending: drop it in assets/logo.png.
